title: 60 SQL Practice Queries on PostgreSQL
summary: Sixty solved PostgreSQL 16 drills over one employees/departments/orders dataset, ordered from basic filtering through aggregates, joins, subqueries, window functions and CTEs to classic interview scenarios.

chapters.title: 60 SQL Practice Queries (PostgreSQL 16)
points: Every query runs as written on PostgreSQL 16 against one small shared dataset of departments, employees and orders
Ten task families in order: basics, filtering and simple aggregates, grouping, joins, subqueries, window functions, CTEs, interview scenarios
60 tasks, each with the task, the solution code and the exact result

chapters.title: SQL Drills Cheatsheet
points: Logical execution order: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, SELECT, window functions, ORDER BY, LIMIT
WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after aggregation
NULL traps: COUNT(col) skips NULLs, = NULL never matches, and NOT IN fails with a NULL in the list (use NOT EXISTS)
ROW_NUMBER never ties, RANK leaves gaps after ties, DENSE_RANK leaves none
Pick INNER JOIN for matches only, LEFT JOIN to keep the left side, and LEFT JOIN with IS NULL for 'has no match'
